Title: `references_hash_tool.py` (DEL-08-01)
Text: Computes and verifies `ContentHash` fields for out-of-folder references in `_REFERENCES.md`.

Title: Commands
Text: ```bash python3 execution/_Scripts/references_hash_tool.py compute <deliverable_or_references_path> python3 execution/_Scripts/references_hash_tool.py verify <deliverable_or_references_path> python3 execution/_Scripts/references_hash_tool.py recompute <deliverable_or_references_path> ```

Title: Output and Exit Codes
Text: - `compute` / `recompute`   - `0`: completed (file may or may not have changed)   - `2`: invalid path or runtime error - `verify`   - `0`: verification passed (or bypass recorded with `--allow-bypass`)   - `1`: verification failed   - `2`: invalid path, missing bypass metadata, or runtime error

Title: Bypass Recording
Text: Use only with explicit human approval:  ```bash python3 execution/_Scripts/references_hash_tool.py verify <path> \   --allow-bypass --actor "<actor>" --reason "<reason>" ```  By default, bypass records append to deliverable-local `HASH_VERIFICATION_BYPASS.jsonl`.

Title: Output and Exit Codes
Text: - `0`: all files pass (warnings allowed) - `1`: one or more schema validation failures - `2`: unreadable/missing inputs or tool failure
